verdict.rationale: Serving multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model is a fair question for a local LLM runtime and server like LM Studio, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents model loading, the local server, and on-demand loading, but never mentions LoRA adapters or multi-adapter serving. Loading separate whole models with identifiers is a different feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
